title: Plan select
description: Full-viewport plan choice composing the pricing block: one card per plan, the recommended one highlighted, with the block's loading, error and empty renders. Presentational — plans and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm and the footer at @md, while the plans inside go side by side at the block's own @md.
